ar.explain.addStory: يدرج قصة مستخدم جديدة بنفس تخطيط بطاقات القصص في الوثيقة، بحقول جاهزة للكتابة.
ar.explain.storyPoint: يضيف نقطة قبول إلى قصة المستخدم المحددة، بعد النقطة المحددة.
ar.explain.storyCard: يضيف قصة مستخدم أخرى داخل الكتلة المحددة.
ar.explain.pgBreakAdd: يبدأ القسم المحدد في صفحة جديدة.
ar.explain.pgBreakDel: يزيل فاصل الصفحة قبل القسم المحدد فيُغلق الفراغ.
ar.explain.pgPullUp: يزيل فاصل الصفحة بعد القسم المحدد فيصعد المحتوى التالي إلى صفحته.
ar.explain.secDel: يحذف القسم المحدد بعنوانه ومحتواه ويغلق الفراغ؛ يمكن التراجع.
ar.explain.pgEmpty: يحذف الفقرات الفارغة ويزيل فاصل الصفحة قبل أي قسم لم يبق فيه شيء.
ar.explain.renumList: يبدأ القائمة المرقّمة من رقم تختاره أو يتابع ترقيم القائمة السابقة.
ar.explain.pvOpen: يفتح سجل المصدر: من غيّر ماذا ومتى، في سلسلة موقّعة يُكشف فيها أي حذف أو تعديل.
ar.explain.pvSign: يوقّع الحالة الحالية للوثيقة باسمك في سجل المصدر.
ar.explain.lkToggle: يقفل الوثيقة فلا تُعدَّل، أو يفتحها بعد تنبيه؛ بلا كلمة مرور.
ar.explain.shShare: يحفظ نسخة HTML للمشاركة مع زميل، ومعها سجل المصدر وحالة القفل.
ar.explain.docId: يغيّر رقم الوثيقة في كل موضع يظهر فيه: الغلاف والترويسة وجدول الإصدارات.
ar.explain.rbtab_file: حفظ الوثيقة وتصديرها ومشاركتها، أو بدء وثيقة جديدة.
ar.explain.rbtab_home: الأدوات اليومية: تراجع وبحث، وتنسيق النص والفقرة، وإدارة الكتلة المحددة.
ar.explain.rbtab_insert: يضيف صورًا وشعارات ومخططات وجداول وأقسامًا وقصصًا.
ar.explain.rbtab_layout: حجم الصفحة وفواصلها، والترويسة والتذييل، والفهرس.
ar.explain.rbtab_design: ألوان الوثيقة وخطوطها، وشكل الكتلة المحددة.
ar.explain.rbtab_review: الفحص والسجل والمخطط الزمني، والتوقيع والقفل.
ar.explain.rbtab_view: طريقة عرض الصفحات والتكبير واللغة، والوضعان الداكن والهادئ.
ar.explain.rbtab_table: أدوات الجدول المحدد: صفوف وأعمدة وخلايا.
ar.explain.rbtab_picture: أدوات الصورة المحددة: استبدال وتعليق والتفاف النص حولها.
ar.explain.rbtab_diagram: أدوات المخطط المحدد: الأشكال والأسهم والترتيب والتكبير.
ar.explain.rbtab_export: كل صيغ التصدير في مكان واحد.
ar.explain.rbtab_font: تنسيق النص المحدد: الخط واللون والحجم والتأكيد.
ar.explain.rbtab_hf: الترويسة والتذييل: نصوص وحقول وشعارات ومحاذاة.
ar.explain.rbtab_tools: أدوات إضافية تساعدك في العمل على الوثيقة.
ar.explain.rbtab_diagram2: ترتيب أشكال المخطط: محاذاة وتوزيع وطبقات.
ar.explain.zoomPct: يضبط التكبير على نسبة تختارها بين 25% و400%.
ar.explain.zoomHeight: يكبّر الصفحة حتى تملأ ارتفاع النافذة.
ar.explain.projExport: يصدّر كل وثائق المشروع معًا بالصيغة واللغة اللتين تختارهما، في مجلد أو ملف مضغوط مع فهرس.
ar.explain.projImport: يستورد مجلد مشروع أو ملفًا مضغوطًا أو عدة ملفات دفعة واحدة، ويضعها في المكتبة كمشروع واحد.
ar.explain.spellNext: ينتقل إلى الخطأ الإملائي التالي في الوثيقة.
ar.explain.spellFixAll: يصحّح كل الأخطاء في الوثيقة بأول اقتراح لكل كلمة.
ar.explain.spellIgnore: يتجاهل هذه الكلمة هنا فقط، ويزيل الخط عنها.
ar.explain.spellIgnoreAll: يتجاهل هذه الكلمة في كل الوثيقة.
ar.explain.spellAdd: يضيف الكلمة إلى قاموسك، فلا تُعدّ خطأً بعد الآن.
ar.explain.spellLang: يختار لغة التدقيق: العربية أو الإنجليزية أو الاثنتين معاً.

en.xpl.hint: Rest the pointer on a tool or a tab, or focus it with the keyboard, and its explanation and picture appear here.
en.explain.save: Saves the document itself, in place: its own HTML file in the HTML folder and its Documents entry, and resets the change counter. Without the local server it downloads the edits file.
en.explain.saveHtml: Saves this editor, with your edits, as one HTML file you can open anywhere.
en.explain.import: Opens the file as a document in Documents: a saved or shared HTML, a DOCX, PDF or JSON. An edits file is merged into this document.
en.explain.exportEdits: Downloads this service's edits as one bundle file.
en.explain.exportAll: Downloads the edits of every service in one bundle file.
en.explain.image: Adds an image after the selected block; move it with the Drag handle beside it. Drop or paste an image file on the page to place it freely.
en.explain.logo: Adds a logo on the page; drag it onto the cover, the header or anywhere.
en.explain.addDiagram: Inserts a new workflow diagram you can draw and edit in place.
en.explain.addPara: Adds a new paragraph right after the selected one.
en.explain.redo: Puts back the change you just undid.
en.explain.find: Finds a word in the document and replaces it, one hit or all at once.
en.explain.newdoc: Starts a new document from a model, a merge or a crawl of a site.
en.explain.process: Opens the workflow: its roles and steps, which feed the diagram.
en.explain.outline: Shows the chapters and sections; click one to jump to it.
en.explain.pages: Shows thumbnails of the printed pages; click one to go to it.
en.explain.check: Checks the document for gaps and mistakes and lists what to fix.
en.explain.history: Lists every change, lets you approve or reject it and compare snapshots.
en.explain.renumber: Renumbers chapters, sections and tables in order.
en.explain.webhooks: Sends a notice to your own address when you save or export.
en.explain.theme: Opens the design panel: fonts, colours, sizes and template parts.
en.explain.styleThis: Styles only the selected block: colour, size, spacing, border.
en.explain.hideBlock: Hides the selected block from the page and the export; it is not deleted.
en.explain.side: Shows the Arabic and English editions next to each other.
en.explain.uiLang: Switches the interface between Arabic and English.
en.explain.dir: Sets the direction of the words, right to left or left to right; the layout stays where it is.
en.explain.ed: Switches the interface language and the edition you edit; the layout stays where it is.
en.explain.dark: Switches the editor to dark colours; the document prints the same.
en.explain.calm: Turns animations off for a still, quiet screen.
en.explain.focus: Hides the toolbar so only the page is in view; press F or Esc to return.
en.explain.spell: Underlines spelling mistakes in this edition.
en.explain.snap: Snaps logos and images to the page guides while you drag.
en.explain.zoomOut: Makes the page smaller on screen.
en.explain.zoomIn: Makes the page larger on screen.
en.explain.exportPdf: Exports the document as a PDF and a matching Word file.
en.explain.print: Prints the document exactly as the PDF lays it out.
en.explain.duplicate: Makes a copy of the selected block right under it.
en.explain.delete: Removes the selected block; Undo brings it back.
en.explain.moveUp: Moves the selected block one place up.
en.explain.moveDown: Moves the selected block one place down.
en.explain.comment: Pins a note to the selected block for reviewers; it never prints.
en.explain.breakBefore: Starts a new page before the selected block.
en.explain.keepNext: Keeps the selected block on the same page as the next one.
en.explain.rowAdd: Adds a row under the selected cell.
en.explain.rowDel: Removes the row of the selected cell.
en.explain.colAdd: Adds a column after the selected cell.
en.explain.colDel: Removes the column of the selected cell.
en.explain.rowUp: Moves the selected row one place up.
en.explain.rowDown: Moves the selected row one place down.
en.explain.replace: Swaps the selected image or logo for another file, keeping its place.
en.explain.caption: Writes a caption under the selected image.
en.explain.every: Repeats the selected logo on every page.
en.explain.ovDelete: Removes the selected image or logo.
en.explain.dgStaff: Adds a stage box for a staff step.
en.explain.dgApplicant: Adds a step done by the applicant.
en.explain.dgStart: Adds the start pill where the flow begins.
en.explain.dgRework: Adds a step that sends the request back for completion.
en.explain.dgSystem: Adds a step the system does on its own.
en.explain.dgDecision: Adds a decision diamond with yes and no paths.
en.explain.dgOk: Adds the end where the request is approved.
en.explain.dgStop: Adds the end where the request is refused.
en.explain.dgNote: Adds a note beside the flow.
en.explain.dgGroup: Adds a band that groups steps under one title.
en.explain.dgText: Adds free text anywhere in the drawing.
en.explain.dgAuto: Lays the diagram out again, neat and evenly spaced.
en.explain.dgReset: Goes back to the layout the diagram was harvested with.
en.explain.dgFlow: Turns the flow to run across or down.
en.explain.dgLegend: Shows or hides the key under the diagram.
en.explain.dgMermaidIn: Builds the diagram from Mermaid text.
en.explain.dgMermaidOut: Copies the diagram out as Mermaid text.
en.explain.dgLabel: Edits the text of the selected shape in place.
en.explain.dgSub: Edits the small caption under the shape's text.
en.explain.dgConnect: Draws an arrow from this shape; click the shape it goes to.
en.explain.dgDup: Makes a copy of the selected shape.
en.explain.dgDel: Removes the selected shape or arrow.
en.explain.dgFront: Brings the selected shape in front of the others.
en.explain.dgBack: Sends the selected shape behind the others.
en.explain.dgAlignL: Lines the selected shapes up on their left edges.
en.explain.dgAlignC: Lines the selected shapes up on their centres.
en.explain.dgAlignR: Lines the selected shapes up on their right edges.
en.explain.dgAlignT: Lines the selected shapes up on their tops.
en.explain.dgAlignM: Lines the selected shapes up on their middles.
en.explain.dgAlignB: Lines the selected shapes up on their bottoms.
en.explain.dgDistH: Spaces the selected shapes evenly across.
en.explain.dgDistV: Spaces the selected shapes evenly down.
en.explain.dgWrap: Puts the selected shapes inside one titled band.
en.explain.dgEdgeLabel: Edits the words on the selected arrow.
en.explain.dgBendAdd: Adds a bend you can drag to reshape the arrow.
en.explain.dgBendDel: Removes the last bend from the arrow.
en.explain.dgRouteAuto: Lets the arrow find its own clean path again.
en.explain.dgReverse: Turns the arrow to point the other way.
en.explain.dgFrom: Moves the start of the arrow to another shape.
en.explain.dgTo: Moves the end of the arrow to another shape.
en.explain.dgZoomIn: Zooms into the drawing (Ctrl + wheel works too).
en.explain.dgZoomFit: Fits the whole drawing in its frame.
en.explain.dgZoom100: Shows the drawing at its real size.
en.explain.palette: Opens every command in one searchable list (Ctrl+K).
en.explain.view: Opens the view options: page mode, dark, calm, focus, zoom.
en.explain.more: Shows the rest of this section's tools.
en.explain.svc: Picks which service's document you are editing.
en.explain.both: Applies a change to the Arabic and the English edition together.
en.explain.dg_wire: Picks the kind of arrow: normal, return, payment and so on.
en.explain.dg_kind: Changes what the selected shape stands for.
en.explain.dg_color: Picks the shape's colour, or lets its kind decide.
en.explain.dg_badge: Puts a small symbol badge on the shape.
en.explain.dg_icon: Picks the symbol this shape shows.
en.explain.dg_symbol: Adds a symbol to the drawing.
en.explain.view.mode: How pages show on screen: one long sheet, one page, or an open book.
en.explain.view.continuous: Shows the document as one long sheet you scroll.
en.explain.view.single: Shows one page at a time; turn pages with the arrows or Page Up / Page Down.
en.explain.view.spread: Shows two pages side by side like an open book, the cover on its own.
en.explain.view.prev: Goes back one page (or one spread).
en.explain.view.next: Goes on one page (or one spread).
en.explain.k_close: Closes this panel; your selection stays.
en.explain.k_q: Type the word to look for.
en.explain.k_r: Type the word to put in its place.
en.explain.k_next: Goes to the next place the word appears.
en.explain.k_all: Replaces the word everywhere at once.
en.explain.k_snap: Keeps a snapshot of the document now, to compare with later.
en.explain.k_log: Downloads the list of changes as a file.
en.explain.font.pick: Opens the font list: the project's fonts, this computer's fonts and fonts you uploaded, with a live preview.
en.explain.font.local: Lets the editor read the fonts installed on this computer (the browser asks you once).
en.explain.font.upload: Adds a font file (TTF, OTF, WOFF) from your computer to this document.
en.explain.font.remove: Removes an uploaded font from this document.
en.explain.vc.slider: Drag to change the value; the page follows as you move.
en.explain.vc.number: Type an exact value; digits and a decimal point only.
en.explain.vc.unit: Picks the unit; the value converts so the size stays the same.
en.explain.design.swatch: Picks a colour from the palette.
en.explain.design.hex: Type a colour code such as #003C7A; empty goes back to the design's colour.
en.explain.design.part: Shows or hides this part of the template (cover, control data, contents…).
en.explain.design.move: Moves this part of the template up or down in the document.
en.explain.design.label: Changes a printed label (a heading or a field name) for this document.
en.explain.k_laball: Applies label changes to every document that uses this design.
en.explain.k_addTable: Adds a new table to the template.
en.explain.k_addSection: Adds a new section to the template.
en.explain.k_dcssApply: Applies your own CSS to the page; it is checked before it runs.
en.explain.k_sthide: Hides the selected block from the page and the export.
en.explain.k_stclear: Removes this block's own styling; it takes the design's look again.
en.explain.k_embed: Puts the fonts inside the saved HTML so it looks the same on any computer.
en.explain.k_docxFonts: Puts the fonts inside the Word file so it opens right without installing them.
en.explain.k_texp: Downloads this design (colours, fonts, sizes) as a design pack.
en.explain.k_timp: Loads a design pack and applies it to the document.
en.explain.k_logoAdd: Adds a logo on the page; drag it onto the cover, the header or anywhere.
en.explain.settings: Shows the software's details, its update state and your preferences.
en.explain.library: Opens Documents: everything you saved in this browser, and the templates. Open here or in a new tab, start a new document, import PDF, DOCX or HTML, or delete.
en.explain.timeline: Opens Changes: a timeline of every edit since the last Save HTML, with back, forward and checkpoints.
en.explain.export.menu: Every export format in one place: PDF, DOCX, HTML, edits, design pack and the diagram, one click each.
en.explain.export.pdf.ar: Makes a PDF of the Arabic edition as shown here, without the watermark.
en.explain.export.pdf.en: Makes a PDF of the English edition as shown here, without the watermark.
en.explain.export.pdf.both: Makes two PDFs, Arabic then English.
en.explain.export.docx.ar: Makes a Word file of the Arabic edition with its fonts (needs the local server).
en.explain.export.docx.en: Makes a Word file of the English edition with its fonts (needs the local server).
en.explain.export.docx.both: Makes two Word files, Arabic then English (needs the local server).
en.explain.export.html: Saves this service with its edits as one editable HTML file.
en.explain.export.printHtml: Saves the print HTML page the engine prints the PDF from.
en.explain.export.edits: Downloads this service's edits as a JSON file.
en.explain.export.editsAll: Downloads every service's edits as one JSON file.
en.explain.export.pack: Downloads the design pack: colours, fonts and edited labels.
en.explain.export.mermaid: Downloads the workflow diagram as Mermaid text.
en.explain.export.svg: Downloads the workflow diagram as an SVG vector image.
en.explain.export.png: Downloads the workflow diagram as a PNG at double resolution.
en.explain.zoomFit: Zooms the page to fill the window's width.
en.explain.powerOff: Turns all of Business-Wrap off: saves your open documents, then stops the local host and every process it started, and closes its windows. It asks first.
en.explain.bulkEdit: Changes a field, a section or a text in a whole project or in documents you pick, after a preview per document, with an undo per document.
en.explain.reading: Hides the tools and every editing aid and shows the pages one at a time, for reading and review only. Turn pages with the arrows, PageUp / PageDown or Space; leave with Esc or the visible button. Nothing in the document changes.
en.explain.hdrText: Adds a text to the header, on every page after the cover.
en.explain.hdrField: Adds a document field to the header: code, issue date, version, page number and more.
en.explain.hdrLogo: Adds a logo image to the header.
en.explain.hdrConf: Edits the confidentiality label the footer prints.
en.explain.ftrText: Adds a text to the footer, on every page after the cover.
en.explain.ftrField: Adds a document field to the footer, the page number among them.
en.explain.chStart: Moves the picked item to the start of the band.
en.explain.chCenter: Moves the picked item to the middle of the band.
en.explain.chEnd: Moves the picked item to the end of the band.
en.explain.chDelete: Deletes the picked header or footer item.
en.explain.chScope: Cycles the item scope: every page, this page only, from this page on.
en.explain.hdrStart: Aligns the picked header item to the start of the line.
en.explain.hdrEnd: Aligns the picked header item to the end of the line.
en.explain.hdrDelete: Deletes the picked header item; Undo brings it back.
en.explain.hdrScope: Switches the picked header item between every page, this page only, and from this page on.
en.explain.ftrStart: Aligns the picked footer item to the start of the line.
en.explain.ftrEnd: Aligns the picked footer item to the end of the line.
en.explain.ftrDelete: Deletes the picked footer item; Undo brings it back.
en.explain.ftrScope: Switches the picked footer item between every page, this page only, and from this page on.
en.explain.fmtCode: Marks the selected text as code.
en.explain.fmtLink: Turns the selected text into a link (https or mailto).
en.explain.fmtColor: Changes the colour of the selected text.
en.explain.fmtFont: Sets the selected text in another Thmanyah family.
en.explain.fmtSize: Changes the size of the selected text, in points.
en.explain.fmtClear: Removes the formatting from the selected text.
en.explain.fmtAlignStart: Aligns the paragraph to the start.
en.explain.fmtAlignEnd: Aligns the paragraph to the end.
en.explain.fmtTop: Puts the cell or box text at the top.
en.explain.fmtMiddle: Puts the cell or box text in the middle.
en.explain.fmtBottom: Puts the cell or box text at the bottom.
en.explain.fmtLine: Changes the line spacing of the paragraph.
en.explain.fmtBefore: Changes the space before the paragraph.
en.explain.fmtAfter: Changes the space after the paragraph.
en.explain.fmtQuote: Sets the paragraph as a quote.
en.explain.fmtBullets: Makes the paragraph a bulleted item.
en.explain.fmtNumbers: Makes the paragraph a numbered item.
en.explain.fmtShapes: Makes the paragraph an item with a shape you pick.
en.explain.fmtIndent: Moves the item one level deeper in the list.
en.explain.fmtOutdent: Moves the item one level up in the list.
en.explain.pgSetup: Picks the page size and orientation, for the whole document or this section only.
en.explain.pgBreak: Starts the selected section on a new page, or removes the break.
en.explain.tocHide: Leaves the entry out of the contents; the section stays in the document.
en.explain.tocAdd: Adds a new section after this entry's section, so the contents list it.
en.explain.fmRowAdd: Adds a row to the document control, revisions or questions table.
en.explain.fmRowDel: Deletes the picked row of a front-matter table.
en.explain.fmColAdd: Adds a column to the document control table.
en.explain.fmColDel: Deletes the picked column of the document control table.
en.explain.ruler: Shows a centimetre ruler above each page at its real width, so a landscape page has its own width and margins.
en.explain.insTable: Inserts a table of the size you pick after the selection, with a header row.
en.explain.insSection: Inserts a new section into the selected chapter.
en.explain.insChapter: Inserts a new chapter after the selected one.
en.explain.insTextBox: Inserts a text box tied to the selected block; type in it and drag it anywhere.
en.explain.copyBlock: Copies the whole selected block, to paste here or in another document.
en.explain.pasteBlock: Pastes the copied block after the selection.
en.explain.wrapInline: Puts the image back in line with the text.
en.explain.wrapSquare: Wraps the text around the image's box.
en.explain.wrapTight: Wraps the text around the image's shape.
en.explain.wrapThrough: Wraps the text through the image's shape, closer still.
en.explain.wrapTopBottom: Puts the image on its own line, text above and below.
en.explain.wrapBehind: Puts the image behind the text.
en.explain.wrapFront: Puts the image in front of the text.
en.explain.cellMerge: Merges the selected cells into one cell.
en.explain.cellSplit: Splits merged cells back into their cells.
en.explain.cellWrap: Switches text wrapping inside the cell.
en.explain.cellFill: Colours the background of the selected cells.
en.explain.cellColW: Sets one width for the selected columns.
en.explain.cellRowH: Sets one height for the selected rows.
en.explain.cellClearValue: Empties the text of the selected cells and keeps their format.
en.explain.cellClearFormat: Resets font, size, colours and fill of the selected cells to the default.
en.explain.addStory: Inserts a new user story in the same card layout the document uses for stories, with fields ready to type in.
en.explain.storyPoint: Adds an acceptance point to the selected user story, after the selected point.
en.explain.storyCard: Adds another user story inside the selected stories block.
en.explain.pgBreakAdd: Starts the selected section on a new page.
en.explain.pgBreakDel: Removes the page break before the selected section so the gap closes.
en.explain.pgPullUp: Removes the page break after the selected section so the next content moves up onto its page.
en.explain.secDel: Deletes the selected section with its heading and content and closes the gap; undo brings it back.
en.explain.pgEmpty: Deletes empty paragraphs and removes the page break before any section left with nothing.
en.explain.renumList: Starts the numbered list at a number you choose, or continues the previous list.
en.explain.pvOpen: Opens Provenance: who changed what and when, in a signed chain that shows any removed or edited entry.
en.explain.pvSign: Signs the document as it is now, in your name, in the provenance log.
en.explain.lkToggle: Locks the document against edits, or unlocks it after a warning; no password.
en.explain.shShare: Saves an HTML copy to share with a colleague, with its provenance log and lock state.
en.explain.docId: Changes the document ID everywhere it appears: the cover, the header and the version table.
en.explain.rbtab_file: Save, export and share the document, or start a new one.
en.explain.rbtab_home: Everyday tools: undo and find, text and paragraph formatting, and the selected block.
en.explain.rbtab_insert: Adds pictures, logos, diagrams, tables, sections and stories.
en.explain.rbtab_layout: Page size and breaks, the header and footer, and the contents.
en.explain.rbtab_design: The document's colours and fonts, and the look of the selected block.
en.explain.rbtab_review: Checks, history, the timeline, signing and locking.
en.explain.rbtab_view: How pages show, zoom, language, and the dark and calm modes.
en.explain.rbtab_table: Tools for the selected table: rows, columns and cells.
en.explain.rbtab_picture: Tools for the selected picture: swap, caption and text wrap.
en.explain.rbtab_diagram: Tools for the selected diagram: shapes, arrows, arrangement and zoom.
en.explain.rbtab_export: Every export format in one place.
en.explain.rbtab_font: Formats the selected text: font, colour, size and emphasis.
en.explain.rbtab_para: Formats the paragraph: alignment, spacing and lists.
en.explain.rbtab_hf: The header and footer: texts, fields, logos and alignment.
en.explain.rbtab_tools: Extra tools that help you work on the document.
en.explain.rbtab_diagram2: Arranges the diagram shapes: align, distribute and layers.
en.explain.zoomPct: Sets the zoom to a percentage you choose, from 25% to 400%.
en.explain.zoomHeight: Zooms the page to fill the window's height.
en.explain.projExport: Exports every document of the project together, in the format and language you pick, into a folder or one zip with an index.
en.explain.projImport: Imports a project folder, a zip or several files at once, and files them in the library as one project.
en.explain.spellNext: Jumps to the next spelling mistake in the document.
en.explain.spellPrev: Goes back to the previous spelling mistake.
en.explain.spellFix: Corrects the current word with its first suggestion.
en.explain.spellFixAll: Corrects every mistake in the document with each word's first suggestion.
en.explain.spellIgnore: Ignores this word here only and removes its underline.
en.explain.spellIgnoreAll: Ignores this word everywhere in the document.
en.explain.spellAdd: Adds the word to your dictionary so it is no longer flagged.
en.explain.spellCount: Shows how many spelling mistakes are left.
en.explain.spellLang: Chooses the checking language: Arabic, English, or both.
